_comment: Backend coverage ratchet floor. Read by backend/vitest.config.ts — the thresholds live here rather than in code so a change to what the project guarantees is reviewable as data, in a diff, with a reason. THE NUMBERS ONLY GO UP. Lowering one to make a run pass is gaming the gate (~/.claude/rules/never-game-auditors.md); if coverage drops, restore the coverage. Refresh after genuine improvement: npm run baseline:backend-coverage:refresh, which writes current-minus-buffer and requires a human commit stating what was added.
_why: This file exists because the backend number was UNMEASURABLE until 2026-08-19, not merely unmeasured. `vitest run --coverage` failed on a bcrypt-cost-13 timeout, a failing run prints no summary, and so the ~10% figure everyone quoted was the ROOT suite (src/** + codebase-mcp/**), which never touches backend/. An unmeasured good number decays; this is the thing that stops it.
_buffer: 2 points below measured — absorbs the small run-to-run variance v8 coverage shows on async paths without absorbing a real regression.

_ciiSilver._note: Backend ALREADY clears the CII Silver branch bar (63.96 > 50) and sits ~6.6 points off statements. The coverage blocker for Silver is the frontend, not this. Do not cite a single blended project-coverage figure — say which surface.
